visual.description: Primary white background used across all page sections and the modal dialog.
Black used for large headings, the ETQ logo, and bold typographic statements.
Near-black used for body copy, product names, and descriptive text throughout.
Mid-gray used for secondary labels like material names and supporting descriptors.
Light gray used for strikethrough sale prices and de-emphasized metadata.
Vivid electric blue used for the top announcement/promo banner background.
Off-white light gray used as the product grid section background.
Subtle light gray used for input field borders and dividing lines.
Solid black fill used for the primary CTA button (Sign up) in the modal.
White text and background used for the email input field inside the modal.
Muted warm gray that dominates the editorial and product section backgrounds as a desaturated overlay tone.
